title: KQL osnove
summary: Gdje se piše KQL u Defender portalu (advanced hunting, ograničenja), izbor prave tabele (Device*, Email*, Identity*, Sentinel tabele), osnovni operatori where/project/extend/summarize/bin/top/render, vremenski filteri i string operatori sa pravilima performansi.
summary_en: Where KQL is written in the Defender portal (advanced hunting, limits), choosing the right table (Device*, Email*, Identity*, Sentinel tables), the basic operators where/project/extend/summarize/bin/top/render, time filters and string operators with performance rules.
